## v0.3.2: 2026-09-30

gridappsd-go is a Go client library for GridAPPS-D / GOSS. This patch release
widens the escaping applied to the teardown error text of the token exchange,
so text from a broker can no longer reorder, hide or split part of a log line
in the cases listed below. It changes no exported API.

### What changed

- fix: a backslash in a teardown error is written as `\\`, so a literal `\x0a`
  from the broker no longer reads like an escaped line break (#36).
- fix: C1 control characters, U+2028 and U+2029 are written as `\uNNNN`, and
  each byte of invalid UTF-8 as `\xNN` (#36).
- fix: the 512-byte cut never lands inside an escape, where it could leave a
  dangling `\x` before the truncation note (#36).
- fix: `Error()` escapes only the text the bound keeps, so a very large broker
  message no longer costs several times its size in allocations (#36).
- fix: these Unicode format characters in teardown error text are escaped
  (#39): the Arabic letter mark (U+061C), the left-to-right and right-to-left
  marks (U+200E, U+200F), the zero-width characters (U+200B to U+200D), the
  bidirectional embedding and override controls (U+202A to U+202E), the word
  joiner (U+2060), the bidirectional isolate controls (U+2066 to U+2069) and
  the byte order mark (U+FEFF) are written as `\uNNNN`, and the tag characters
  (U+E0000 to U+E007F) as `\UNNNNNNNN`.

### Known issues (unfixed)

- go-stomp can still keep a goroutine past the close of the credential
  connection, since no public API on this module can close or drain the
  underlying connection (#24).
- Only the format characters listed above are escaped. Other Unicode format
  (Cf) characters, among them U+00AD, U+0600 to U+0605, U+180E, U+2061 to
  U+2064, U+206A to U+206F and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB, are still written as they
  arrive. None starts a new line or reorders text, but they can hide or pad
  broker text in a log (#41).

### Merged pull requests

- #38: escape backslash, C1 and invalid bytes in teardown error text, and keep
  escapes whole at the cut (#36)
- #40: escape Unicode format characters in teardown error text (#39)

### Migration notes

- Database: no migration, this is a library with no persistence.
- Breaking changes: none. The changes are inside the module's internal
  packages and no exported identifier is added, changed or removed.

### Deployment

- Module: `github.com/GRIDAPPSD/gridappsd-go@v0.3.2`
- No container image: this is a Go library, not a deployable service.
